description: This Java source file defines an abstract assertion class 'AbstractJsonifiableAssert' for testing objects implementing the 'Jsonifiable' interface. It provides methods to verify JSON string equality, schema versions, and supported versions, utilizing external libraries like AssertJ, JSONAssert, and classes related to JSON schema versions.

classes.name: AbstractJsonifiableAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for objects implementing 'Jsonifiable', providing custom assertions for JSON output and schema version checks.

methods.name: AbstractJsonifiableAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assert with the actual 'Jsonifiable' object and the class type.

methods.name: hasJsonString
methods.description: Checks whether the 'Jsonifiable' produces the expected JSON string, using JSONAssert for comparison.

methods.name: hasLatestSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the actual object's latest schema version matches the expected.

methods.name: supportSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the actual object supports one or more specified schema versions.

methods.name: implementsSchemaVersion
methods.description: Verifies that the actual object implements the specified schema version.
